title: Agent 技能包与工作流工具集中出现
opening: 今天榜单几乎被 Agent 技能包和配套工具占满，从安全测试、选题调研到代码审查、工作流编排，都在把 Claude Code 这类编码代理往更具体的专业场景里推。最值得看的是 Claude-BugHunter 和 last30days-skill：前者把漏洞挖掘方法论拆成 82 个技能，后者用 Reddit、X、Polymarket 的投票和真金白银给话题排序。

projects.name: alibaba/open-code-review
projects.description: Secure, fast, efficient, battle-tested at Alibaba's scale. Hybrid architecture code review tool: deterministic pipelines + LLM Agent, precise line-level comments, built-in multi-language ruleset (NPE, thread-safety, XSS, SQL injection), OpenAI & Anthropic compatible.
projects.readmeExcerpt: OpenCodeReview English | 简体中文 | 日本語 | 한국어 | Русский What is Open Code Review? Open Code Review is an AI-powered code review CLI tool. It originated as Alibaba Group's internal official AI code review assistant — over the past two years, it has served tens of thousands of developers and identified millions of code defects. After thorough validation at massive scale, we incubated it into an open source project for the community. Simply configure a model endpoint to get started. It reads Git diffs, sends changed files to a configurable LLM via an agent with tool-use capabilities, and generates structured review comments with line-level precision. The agent can read full file contents, search the codebase, inspect other changed files for context, and produce deep reviews — not just surface-level diff feedback. Beyond diff review, `ocr scan` reviews entire files for auditing unfamiliar codebases or directories that have no meaningful diff. Visit the official website for more details. projects.summary: 阿里内部打磨两年的 AI 代码审查 CLI，用确定性管线加 LLM Agent 做行级评论。
projects.problem: 它不只读 diff，还能让代理翻全文、搜代码库、看其他改动文件来补上下文，内置 NPE、线程安全、XSS、SQL 注入等多语言规则。README 称同模型下精度和 F1 高于通用代理，token 消耗约为九分之一，但需要自配模型端点。

projects.name: ag-ui-protocol/ag-ui
projects.description: AG-UI: the Agent-User Interaction Protocol. Bring Agents into Frontend Applications.
projects.readmeExcerpt: The open protocol that connects any agent to any app. **Docs** · **Examples** · **Spec** · **Discord** **AG-UI is an open, lightweight, event-based protocol that standardizes how AI agents connect to user-facing applications.** Agents don't fit the request/response model. They stream tokens, call tools mid-response, update shared state, pause for a human, and spawn subagents, and every framework does it differently. AG-UI replaces that custom wiring with one bi-directional event stream: the agent emits typed events, and any client can render them, no matter which framework built the agent. The same agent can power a web app, a mobile app, a terminal, or Slack. > [!IMPORTANT] > **AG-UI 1.0 is here.** The protocol now has a stable, frozen specification backed by a JSON Schema, and the TypeScript, Python, and .NET SDKs are generated from it. 1.0 is backwards compatible in both directions: 0.x agents work with 1.0 clients and vice versa. What changed → · Migration guide → Quick start **Start a new app.** The CLI scaffolds a frontend (CopilotKit on Next.js, or a terminal client) wired to the agent framework you pick: Then follow the printed next steps. projects.summary: 一个开放的事件协议，把任意代理接到任意前端应用，1.0 规范已冻结。
projects.problem: 代理不是请求响应模型：它流式吐 token、中途调工具、更新共享状态、等人确认、再派子代理。AG-UI 用一条双向事件流替掉各家自定义接线，TypeScript、Python、.NET SDK 从 JSON Schema 生成，0.x 与 1.0 双向兼容。

closing: 今天的信号很集中：大家不再满足于让代理“能聊”，而是给它装技能、定流程、加审批、接前端。真正稀缺的不是又一个技能包，而是像 AG-UI 这样让代理和界面说同一种话的底层约定。
